subject: Physics
title: Current Electricity
summary: Current = charge flow ki rate, I = dq/dt. Conductor mein electrons random ghoomte hain; field lagne par unhe ek chhoti average drift velocity milti hai (~10⁻⁴ m/s) — I = neAv_d. Bulb turant isliye jalta hai kyunki field poori wire mein lagbhag light ki speed se failta hai.

Ohm's law V = IR (constant temperature par). Resistance material (ρ), lambai aur area par depend karta hai: R = ρl/A. Metals ka resistance temperature ke saath badhta hai, semiconductors ka ghatta hai.
Real cell ka emf E aur internal resistance r: terminal voltage V = E − Ir (discharge). Series mein R jodte hain, parallel mein 1/R. Power P = VI = I²R = V²/R; max power tab jab load R = r.

Kirchhoff ke do niyam (junction: ΣI = 0 — charge conservation; loop: ΣV = 0 — energy conservation) se koi bhi circuit hal hota hai. Wheatstone bridge balance P/Q = R/S; meter bridge isi se unknown resistance naapta hai.

formulas.name: Electric current
formulas.formula: I = dq/dt;   average I = Δq/Δt;   1 A = 1 C/s
formulas.mistake: Current scalar hai — direction hote hue bhi vector ki tarah nahi judta.

formulas.name: Drift velocity and mobility
formulas.formula: I = neAv_d;   v_d = eEτ/m;   mobility μ = v_d/E = eτ/m
formulas.mistake: v_d bahut chhoti (~mm/s) hai; electrons ki thermal speed ~10⁵ m/s alag cheez hai.

formulas.name: Current density and microscopic Ohm's law
formulas.formula: J = I/A = nev_d;   J = σE;   σ = 1/ρ = ne²τ/m
formulas.when: Field aur current ka local relation.

formulas.name: Ohm's law and resistance
formulas.formula: V = IR;   R = ρl/A;   unit ohm (Ω)
formulas.mistake: Ohm's law sabhi devices par nahi lagta — diode, thermistor non-ohmic hain.

formulas.name: Stretching a wire
formulas.formula: Volume same: l → nl ⇒ R → n²R;   radius → r/n ⇒ R → n⁴R
formulas.mistake: Lambai double karne par area aadha bhi hota hai — isliye 4 guna, 2 guna nahi.

formulas.name: Temperature dependence
formulas.formula: ρ_T = ρ₀[1 + α(T − T₀)];   R_T = R₀[1 + α(T − T₀)]
formulas.note: Metals ka α positive, semiconductors ka negative; alloys (manganin, constantan) ka bahut kam.

formulas.name: Colour code
formulas.formula: B B R O Y G B V G W = 0–9 (Black Brown Red Orange Yellow Green Blue Violet Grey White);  pehle do band digits, teesra multiplier (10ⁿ), chautha tolerance (gold 5%, silver 10%, none 20%)

formulas.name: Series and parallel resistors
formulas.formula: Series: R = R₁ + R₂ + … (same I);   parallel: 1/R = 1/R₁ + 1/R₂ + … (same V)
formulas.note: Parallel ka equivalent sabse chhote resistor se bhi chhota.

formulas.name: EMF, internal resistance, terminal voltage
formulas.formula: I = E/(R + r);   discharge V = E − Ir;   charging V = E + Ir;   open circuit V = E
formulas.mistake: Terminal voltage emf se zyada sirf charging ke waqt.

formulas.name: Cells in series and parallel
formulas.formula: n series: E_eq = nE, r_eq = nr;   m parallel (identical): E_eq = E, r_eq = r/m;   mixed: I = nE/(R + nr/m)
formulas.mistake: Ulta joda hua cell (reverse) emf ghatata hai, r phir bhi judta hai.

formulas.name: Electric power and energy
formulas.formula: P = VI = I²R = V²/R;   energy = Pt;   1 kWh = 3.6 × 10⁶ J
formulas.note: Series mein I same ⇒ zyada R zyada jalta; parallel mein V same ⇒ kam R zyada jalta.

formulas.name: Maximum power transfer
formulas.mistake: Max power par efficiency sirf 50% hoti hai.

formulas.name: Kirchhoff's rules
formulas.formula: Junction: ΣI_in = ΣI_out (charge conservation);   loop: ΣΔV = 0 (energy conservation)
formulas.note: Loop mein battery − se + jaate waqt +E, resistor mein current ki direction mein −IR.

formulas.name: Wheatstone bridge
formulas.formula: Balanced: P/Q = R/S ⇒ galvanometer mein current zero
formulas.note: Balance par galvanometer wali branch hata do — circuit simple ho jaata hai.

formulas.name: Meter bridge
formulas.formula: X/R = l/(100 − l)   (l cm, unknown X ki taraf)
formulas.note: Balance point beech mein ho to error kam (end correction).

examples.title: Drift velocity
examples.problem: 1 mm² area ki copper wire mein 1.5 A, n = 8.5 × 10²⁸ m⁻³. v_d?

examples.title: Wire kheenchi
examples.problem: 10 Ω wire ko double lambai tak kheencha (volume same). Naya R?

examples.title: Network
examples.problem: 2, 3, 6 Ω parallel mein, phir 4 Ω series mein; 10 V battery. Total R aur current?

examples.title: Real cell
examples.problem: E = 12 V, r = 0.5 Ω, R = 5.5 Ω. Current aur terminal voltage?

examples.title: Max power
examples.problem: E = 12 V, r = 2 Ω. Load se max power?
examples.solution: R = r = 2 Ω par P = E²/4r = 144/8 = 18 W.

examples.title: Cells in series
examples.problem: 4 cells (1.5 V, 0.5 Ω each) series mein, R = 4 Ω. Current?

examples.title: Kirchhoff: do battery
examples.problem: 6 V (2 Ω branch) aur 3 V (1 Ω branch) parallel mein, dono 2 Ω load ko feed karte hain. Load current aur branch currents?
examples.solution: Top node voltage V: (6 − V)/2 + (3 − V)/1 = V/2 ⇒ V = 3 V. Load = 1.5 A; 6 V branch = 1.5 A; 3 V branch = 0 A (3 V cell na charge ho raha na discharge).

examples.title: Meter bridge
examples.problem: Right gap mein 30 Ω, balance left end se 40 cm par. Unknown X?

examples.title: Bulb aadhe voltage par
examples.problem: 100 W, 220 V bulb ko 110 V par chalaya. R aur power?
examples.solution: R = V²/P = 484 Ω. P = 110²/484 = 25 W (chautha hissa).

examples.title: Colour code
examples.problem: Brown, black, red, gold bands. Resistance?

topics.title: Electric current aur drift
topics.explain: Wire mein free electrons ~10⁵ m/s se random ghoomte hain, net flow zero. Field lagne par unhe drift milta hai. Relaxation time τ do collisions ke beech ka average time; temperature badhne par τ ghatta hai, isliye metal ka ρ badhta hai.

topics.title: Ohmic aur non-ohmic
topics.explain: Ohmic: V–I graph seedhi line origin se (metals, constant T par). Non-ohmic: diode (ek direction), thermistor, GaAs (negative resistance region), electrolytes.

topics.title: Resistivity ka comparison
topics.explain: Metals ~10⁻⁸ Ω·m, semiconductors beech mein, insulators ~10¹⁴ Ω·m se zyada. Nichrome heater element (high ρ, high melting point); manganin/constantan standard resistors (α bahut kam); copper connecting wires (kam ρ).

topics.title: Cells: emf aur terminal voltage
topics.explain: Emf cell ki electric energy per unit charge dene ki capacity hai, potential difference nahi. Current lene par internal resistance mein voltage drop hota hai. Lambi chalne wali battery ka r badh jaata hai.

topics.title: Kirchhoff se hal karne ka tarika
topics.explain: Har branch ka current maan lo (direction galat ho to answer negative aayega). Junction rule independent junctions par, loop rule independent loops par. Equations solve karo. Symmetric circuits mein same potential wale points jodkar ya todkar simplify karo.

topics.title: Wheatstone bridge aur meter bridge
topics.explain: Bridge balance par galvanometer ke dono end same potential par. Meter bridge mein 1 m uniform wire (manganin/constantan) par jockey khiska kar balance dhoondhte hain. Sensitivity zyada jab chaaron resistance lagbhag barabar.

topics.title: Heating effect
topics.explain: Joule heating H = I²Rt. Fuse wire ka melting point kam aur resistance zyada — zyada current par pighal kar circuit tod deta hai. Electric power transmission high voltage par taaki I²R loss kam ho.
